name: Gralor Hespic
keeps: the weights, and the habit of checking them
does: Signs at one door and no other. If she will not sign, that door does not move.
reason: He confessed unprompted to crimes nobody had accused him of.
text: Gralor hespic of the long gallery, keeps a door for the 9th tranche, doors 77 to 85. Keeps the weights, and the habit of checking them. Reads Major Thomas Weir.
